meta.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
meta.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行执行多个独立任务，无需等待顺序完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时处理多个互不依赖的任务
copy.tagline_en: Execute multiple independent tasks in parallel without waiting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to handle multiple independent tasks simultaneously

howto.what: 面对多个互不相关任务时，Claude 会把每个任务派给一个专属子代理并行处理；子代理只拿到所需信息、不带当前对话背景。最后它汇总报告、检查冲突并跑全量测试。
howto.when: 当用户面临 2 个以上互不相关、且无需共享状态或先后依赖的任务时触发，如不同测试文件、子系统、bug 分别失败。

say.text: 我有3个测试文件分别失败，原因互不相关，请并行派代理修复。
say.note: Claude 会为每个文件派一个代理并行修。

say.text: 这两个子系统故障没有依赖，请各派一个子代理并行排查。
say.note: 两个子代理互不干扰，各自独立调查。

say.text: 请把这三个独立 bug 分给不同代理并行处理，最后汇总报告。
say.note: 各代理并行运行，结束后返回各自总结。

howto.what_en: When facing multiple unrelated tasks, Claude delegates each to its own subagent and runs them in parallel; each subagent gets only the information needed for its task, not the session's context. Finally Claude reviews summaries, checks for conflicts, and runs the full test suite.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user faces 2+ independent tasks with no shared state or sequential dependencies, e.g., different test files, subsystems, or bugs failing separately.

say_en.text: Dispatch parallel agents to fix 3 unrelated test file failures.
say_en.note: One subagent per file, running in parallel.

say_en.text: Investigate these two independent subsystem issues with separate subagents.
say_en.note: They run in parallel without interfering with each other.

say_en.text: Please split these three independent bugs across agents and report back.
say_en.note: Each agent works in parallel and returns its own summary.
